features.description: Freeze datetime SMT semantics, classify the builtin surface, and add red-first parity tests
acceptance_criteria: Tests fail for the intended missing datetime capability before implementation.
Each accepted formula has positive, negative, and boundary parity cases.
Every `_dt_*` builtin has an explicit encode/defer classification.
The zero-argument issue is linked separately or shown to be fixed incidentally.

features.description: Implement one shared typed mapping and exact SMT encoder for addDays, startOfDay, and weekday
acceptance_criteria: All three functions emit frozen formulas for direct and curried Core shapes.
Fragment checker and encoder agree on mapped and unmapped operations.
Unsupported datetime functions remain named skips.
The focused SMT test suite passes.

features.description: Add Daneel's window proof, runnable contract example, real-Z3 controls, and documentation
acceptance_criteria: The addDays-based 90-day window verifies with real Z3.
The example type-checks, runs, and asserts verify counts.
startOfDay and weekday verify over the symbolic negative domain.
Focused and full validation commands pass.
